rules: No new motif, color, angle, radius, or motion grammar is authorized.
Theme geometry is identical in light and dark; only declared theme tokens change.
Expressive items are limited to waiting, transition, success, empty, or explicitly ambient presentation regions.
Every animated item must implement the global.reduced-motion static-state rule.
A geometry-only mapping uses no motif and states: no artifact claims this, geometry only.

kira.geometry: Sparse 1.5px support traces with 3px nodes; no diagonal axis is introduced.
kira.carrier: Background trace field carries the circuit node line.

mochi.geometry: Sparse parallel horizontal fine rules only; no literal orthogonal grid is claimed.
mochi.carrier: Background rule field carries the ribbon.

atlas.geometry: Measured survey field of outlined and filled 45° diamonds aligned to structure.
atlas.carrier: Background survey field carries the diamond grid.

atomicComponents.motion: Static by default; optional entrance uses only the character text-reveal cadence.
atomicComponents.reducedMotion: Render the final static field.

kira.geometry: One thin authored ring with an anchored stem; no broad cyan radial fill.
kira.carrier: Localized background anchor carries the collar ring and stem.

mochi.geometry: Localized concentric rose wash using the restrained 22%/50% veil construction.
mochi.carrier: Localized background wash carries the veil.

atlas.geometry: Outlined ring with a filled core, emitted as small measured data rather than a broad fill.
atlas.carrier: Localized background anchor carries the core ring.

atomicComponents.motion: Optional one-shot settle uses the character success cadence; never loops.
atomicComponents.reducedMotion: Render the final static ring or wash.

kira.geometry: Paired thin lines follow the sole 114° directional axis.
kira.carrier: Background sweep carries the fringe diagonal.

mochi.geometry: A measured quadratic fabric curve replaces any literal beam treatment.

atlas.geometry: Paired 2.2px/1.6px near-vertical lines use the authored 76° pitch.
atlas.carrier: Background ray field carries the beam.

atomicComponents.motion: Transition-only sweep uses the existing skeleton timing for each character.
atomicComponents.reducedMotion: Render the final static lines or curve.

policy.pairingRestriction: New items may use only the pairings listed here. Any additional pairing discovered in Phase B requires a new report before implementation.

failures.handling: The cyan accent may remain decorative hairline/emphasis, but cannot be the sole indicator, boundary, or affordance. Functional state must also use foreground text, geometry, native semantics, or another passing non-color cue. No token adjustment proposed.
Gold on background may remain nonessential hairline trim only. Functional gold markers must sit on surface (3.0444:1) or be paired with a passing shape/text cue. No token adjustment proposed.

contrastAudit.result: All proposed body-text pairings pass WCAG AA. The three reported non-text UI failures are explicitly constrained to decorative/non-sole-indicator use; no token values are changed.

nextGate: Await explicit Phase A inventory approval before creating any registry item or block.
